easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
description:
Activate Junk Golem by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers, pairing it and the Servo.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
